svg.aria-label: Top: SAXPY on the example. Each result 7, 15, 6, ... 18 comes from its own column only, so all 12 can be computed in 1 step. Bottom, for contrast: the running sum of y, 3, 4, 8, 9, 14, 23, 25, 31, 36, 39, 44, 52, where each result needs the previous one, a chain of 12 steps.
svg.text: SAXPY uses only its own column; a running sum needs the result before it.

g.text: SAXPY: each result comes from its own column
12 results in 1 step: no arrow runs between columns
For contrast, a running sum: each result needs the one before
